host: node packages/llvm-emscripten/test/check.mjs --tarball <package.tgz>: unpacks the package, checks manifest.json and the files it names, compares lib/clang/24 with the published wasm-clang's, then compiles the generated mains of clang, lld, llvm-ar and llvm-nm with the manifest's multicall flags, links each from the manifest with the same emscripten tree (scripts/emscripten-tree.sh) and runs them under node. A build input has no commands of its own.
checklist: package.json: @ai-ecoverse/llvm-emscripten 24.0.0-N, no install scripts, no slicc.commands; no symlinks; no build path (/home/, /Users/, /__w/, /private/var/, /private/tmp/, the work dir) in any .a, .o, .h, .inc, .def or the manifest

manifest.json: llvm-project b158b0ae; EH js, LLVM_ENABLE_EH/RTTI/LTO/THREADS off; the 128-byte musl sigset_t and the wasm-emscripten patch-set sha256; every object, library and driver main it names is in the package; the 6 tools' link flags are equal (less --gc-sections) and carry no absolute path or realm setting; the generated mains initialize LLVM as wasm-clang's multicall.cpp expects
lib/clang/24 is file for file the published wasm-clang 24.0.0-21's resource dir (its lib/ builtins, which wasm-clang adds from wasix-sysroot, aside)
